fda-device-z-0424-2027.title: FP3D Light Reddish Pink recall (Keystone Industries - Myerstown)
fda-device-z-0424-2027.product: FP3D Light Reddish Pink;  Model/Catalog Number: 4230441;  Product Description: The FP3D is designed for additive manufacturing on Carbon 3D printers (wavelength = 385 nm). FP3D is intended to be used within a computer-aided design and manufacturing (CAD/CAM) digital dentistry system that includes a 3D scanner, design software, 3D printer, post-cure unit (wavelength = 385-405 nm), and post-cure oven for the fabrication of flexible partial dentures for partially edentulous patients.  The device is manufactured using dual-cure technology. The resin consists of two parts (Part A and Part B) that are mixed just before printing. Part A is a UV-curable resin, and Part B is a cross-linking diamine agent. When mixed, the resin undergoes free radical polymerization initiated by a photo-initiator in the presence of a UV light source during the 3D printing process. After printing, the device is then thermally cured in an oven to complete polymerization.
fda-device-z-0424-2027.reason: Some resin cartridges may have been filled without Part B resin. If an affected cartridge is used, the resin may look discolored when dispensed or after post-curing and printed parts may be less flexible and durable.
fda-device-z-0424-2027.distribution: Worldwide distribution - US Nationwide and the country of Canada.
fda-device-z-0424-2027.codes: Box Part No. 4230441;  Cartridge Part No. 4220441;  UDI H66842204410;  All lots;
